title: fetch_chat_lists_to_add_chat begins the Fetch but never records the RequestId (begin() without sent(extra)); in-flight is matched by chat id via has_purpose_for_chat
trigger: open the add-to-folder menu for a chat, then the request is answered or dropped
effect: Loading stage holds no request; a dropped answer cannot be told from a live one, and the answer is matched by purpose+chat instead of the stage's RequestId
fix: call fetch.sent(extra) like fetch_chat_folder_chats_to_leave does and match the answer by the held RequestId

title: probe_self_star_stats calls self_stats.begin() but never sent(request); the Loading stage holds no RequestId and the guard is has_purpose(StarStats{peer})
trigger: open the profile/earn entry with my user id; the StarStats answer is matched by purpose+peer
effect: stage cannot tell its own request from another StarStats{peer} request; a dropped answer leaves Loading with nothing to expire it
fix: self_stats.sent(request) after begin, like app_config in ensure_earn_app_config

title: change_collectible_emoji_status resets StatusChange to Idle and never enters StatusChange::Setting, unlike change_emoji_status
trigger: pick a collectible emoji status; a second SetEmojiStatus answer is only ignored because of the has_purpose guard
effect: StatusChange::Setting{request,emoji} is set on one of two send paths; the collectible path has no stage, so its answer neither remembers pack usage nor is matched by RequestId
fix: enter Setting{request, emoji} on both paths (one helper) or delete the stage if nothing reads it

title: fetch_folder_share does not wait for an in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink; nothing refetches after the delete answers
trigger: delete a folder invite link, close Share Folder and reopen it before the delete answers; getChatFolderInviteLinks is sent while the delete is out and its answer still lists the link
effect: the deleted link reappears in the Share Folder box (as Ready) until the box is reopened again
fix: treat a pending delete as part of the links stage (links Outdated until the delete answers, refetch on its answer), or have fetch_folder_share defer while has_purpose_for_folder(Delete...)

title: pump_one_group_call re-sends the engine mute/camera change every pump after it failed (state map only updated on Ok)
trigger: join a group call where the engine refuses set_group_muted or set_group_camera (no camera, device busy); pump_connected_group_calls runs from request_tick
effect: the engine call is retried on every tick while the call lasts (wasted work, repeated engine/device errors); the user sees the stale error note and no retry cap
fix: hold a per-call Applied/Failed{wanted} stage so a failed change is retried on a user action or timer, not every tick

title: begin_close/release_close drop the error of request_close; a refused close leaves ShutdownPhase::Running and the client waits with nothing left to retry
trigger: quit or switch accounts while the sender refuses the close request (native send fails)
effect: the closing client stays Pending until the receive bridge is seen as lost; no retry of the close request
fix: make a failed close send a ShutdownPhase variant that retries on the next drain or reports Lost

title: disk-paused downloads are tracked in three structures changed by hand together: media.disk_paused (runtime set), data_storage.disk_paused (persisted set) and media.disk_paused_persisted (last saved copy)
trigger: disk goes Low then Healthy, a pause/resume succeeds for some files and a toggle send fails midway
effect: note_disk, pause_download, save_disk_pause/forget_disk_pause and resume_disk_paused_found each touch a different subset; a failed toggle leaves the runtime set and the persisted set out of step until the next ingest repairs it
fix: one DiskPaused owner with pause/resume/commit methods and a dirty marker

title: fetch_poll_option_properties sets poll_option_menu.properties to Loading{request: None} before sending and never records or clears it when the send fails
trigger: open the menu of a poll option while the sender refuses the request
effect: the option menu stays in a request-less Loading stage (no link/delete rows) until the menu is reopened; its answer is matched by chat+message+option_key instead of the RequestId
fix: begin the menu after the send with fetch.sent(extra), and fail it on a refused send

title: request_deep_link_text_from starts a new deep-link stage without the in-flight check request_deep_link_info_from makes
trigger: a pasted text link is looked up while another deep link is ResolvingInfo, ResolvingChat or showing an InvitePreview
effect: start_deep_link replaces the stage whole: the earlier request's answer no longer matches and is dropped, and an open invite preview vanishes
fix: share one guard (refuse while the stage is in flight) between the two entry points

title: revoke_public_link sends the username clear, then fails the whole stage when the second send (disable all usernames) is refused
trigger: revoke a public group link while the second request cannot be sent
effect: the box reports a failed revoke although setSupergroupUsername("") already went out; the link is gone on the server and the UI shows the old state until refetched
fix: keep the first request in the Revoking stage and report a partial result, or send both from one batch

title: new_community_photo is a one-shot slot (RequestId, path) filled when a create is sent and only taken by a successful create answer
trigger: create a community with a photo and the create request fails or its answer is dropped (account switch)
effect: the slot keeps a stale (request, path) pair until the next create overwrites it; nothing clears it on failure
fix: hold the photo in the create request's stage so a failed or dropped create releases it
